from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    company_name: str = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    operating_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities (positive or negative)")
    cash_paid_for_fixed_assets: float = Field(description="Cash paid for purchasing and constructing fixed assets")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all company financial records from the document collection."""
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
